description: Interact with the GitHub REST API: search/read repos, create branches and commits, open PRs, comment, merge, and read workflow checks.

access_token.description: GitHub personal access token (PAT). Saved UnClick GitHub login is used when this is omitted.

action.description: Action: search_repos, get_repo, list_issues, create_issue, list_prs, get_user, list_gists, search_code, create_branch, push_files, create_pull_request, comment_issue_or_pr, merge_pull_request, close_pull_request, list_checks.

api_key.description: GitHub token fallback. Saved UnClick GitHub login is preferred when omitted.

base_branch.description: Base branch for create_branch, push_files branch creation, or pull requests.

body.description: Issue, pull request, or comment body text.

branch.description: Target branch for branch creation, file pushes, pull requests, or checks.

deletions.description: File paths to delete during push_files.

expected_head_sha.description: Optional safety check: fail if the branch head has moved.

files.description: Files for push_files: { path, content, encoding? } entries.

force.description: Force-update the branch ref during push_files. Defaults to false.

labels.description: Comma-separated label names to filter by.

maintainer_can_modify.description: Allow maintainers to modify the pull request branch. Defaults to true.

merge_method.description: Merge method: merge, squash, or rebase. Defaults to squash.

number.description: Issue or pull request number fallback.

pull_number.description: Pull request number for comment_issue_or_pr or merge_pull_request.

query.description: Search query string (for search_repos and search_code).

ref.description: Commit SHA, branch, or tag for list_checks.

state.description: Filter by state: open, closed, all.

name: github_action
